partner_json_extract.hero: Rapido x Navier - India's mobility challenger, on the water
partner_json_extract.why_now: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, ~10x more efficient per passenger-mile, smooth and near-silent, hybrid-capable with no charging dependency, and autonomy-ready. A ~100-vessel network is already ramping in the Maldives next door; Kochi's electric Water Metro proves India's clean-ferry appetite; and India's busiest coastal flows - Mumbai<->Alibaug, Port Blair<->Havelock - run on slow, ageing diesel craft. The category gets claimed cluster-by-cluster.
partner_json_extract.network_thesis: One app. India's 7,500 km coastline. The water layer of India's mobility challenger. | India is a coastline of harbours, tidal rivers, backwaters and island archipelagos - and no mobility platform owns the water. The same in-app foiling tier proven in the Maldives extends to every coastal flow Rapido serves on land: Mumbai's harbour, Goa's coast, Kerala's backwaters, the Andaman islands, Kolkata's Hooghly waterfront and the Chennai/ECR coast. Pick one market to prove it, or roll the recommended sequence. The fleet, app integration and captain-partner model are identical everywhere.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Rapido already runs the hard parts - real-time demand, dispatch, dynamic pricing and a vast captain-partner network across India. A foiling water tier slots straight in: same app, captain-partners on the water, the water leg booked door-to-door with the Rapido auto or bike to and from the jetty.
partner_json_extract.differentiation: {'why_navier': "Software-defined and autonomy-ready; a factory in Turkey for supply; and a ~100-vessel network already proving the model in the Maldives - directly relevant to India's coastline and archipelagos. The water is the ownable surface Rapido's rivals ignore."}
partner_json_extract.the_ask: {'navier_brings': 'The software-defined foiling fleet (Pioneer II + Quanta-LR), captain training, maintenance and the network operating system.', 'partner_brings': 'Demand and dispatch through the Rapido app, the wallet, the brand, and the choice of launch city.', 'next_step': 'Scope a first pilot in one flagship cluster — Mumbai or Goa — co-defining the in-app water format on three corridors.'}
partner_json_extract.close: Bikes. Autos. Cabs. Now the water. | Rapido grew by adding formats faster than anyone. Water is the next one — differentiated demand off the road price war. Start in one harbour, prove the water format, and scale it across India's coast.
